clues: Two great rivers meet at this town. The Sava flows in here and joins the Danube.
This town has four clear times of year, with hot days in the warm months. Cold days come in the dark months, and rain falls all year round.
In 1841 this town was named the chief town of its land once more. That came just past the fight that set the land free.
Men have fought for this town in 115 wars through the years. It was knocked flat 44 times, yet it rose back up each time.
Serbia is run from this town, and the land's chief work of state is done here. More folk live in this town than in any other town in the land.
